Annual Public Budget Hearing – DEC 05, 2024 10:30 a.m.
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a PUBLIC HEARING on the proposed budget for 2025
for the Town of Hortonia will be held on 05 Dec at 10:30 am. in Town Office at 215
West Main St. Hortonville. Budget details will be available for inspection from Clerk Lyn
Neuenfeldt, office 920-216-0932 and on-line.
NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that immediately following the Public Budget Hearing, there
will be a SPECIAL TOWN MEETING of the electors for the following purposes:
1. To adopt the 2024 town tax levy to be paid in 2025 pursuant to §60.10(1)(a) of
Wisconsin State Statutes.
2. To authorize the Town Board to hire Town Officials as employees of the Town and set an
hourly wage pursuant to §60.10(1)(g) of WI State Statutes.
NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that a SPECIAL TOWN BOARD MEETING will be held
immediately following the Special Town meeting. The Town Board meeting will be held to
discuss and adopt the 2025 Budget for the Town of Hortonia.

titulo: Notice of Joint Public Hearing-Rezone Hortonville/Hortonia Fire Dept Building Oct 01, 2024 6pm
texto:
Legal Notice
 
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that at 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday, October 1, 2024 at the Hortonville-Hortonia Fire Department, 700 West Nye Street, Hortonville, the Town of Hortonia Town Board and Plan Commission will conduct a joint public hearing on three related applications submitted by MCC, Inc. and Black Creek Limestone Company regarding their properties located on Givens Road and their properties located in the Northeast Quarter of the Southeast Quarter of Section 30. All applications relate to the proposed expansion of the New London Quarry. The applications consist of the following:
 
·        An application for a Comprehensive Plan Amendment to the Town of Hortonia Future Land Use Map, changing the future land use designation from Residential to Agricultural and/or Quarry for the properties located at W10664, W10620, W10672, and W10606 Givens Road.
 
·        An application for a rezoning of the properties located at W10664, W10620, W10672, and W10606 Givens Road from Residential to A-2 Agricultural.
 
·        An application for a Conditional Use Permit for blasting and non-metallic mineral extraction for the parcels described above as well as additional parcels owned by MCC and located in the Northeast Quarter of the Southeast Quarter of Section 30.
 
The joint public hearing is open to the public and all interested parties are encouraged to attend. Following completion of the public hearing, the Plan Commission will make recommendations to the Town Board regarding each of the applications and the Town Board will take final action thereon.
 
Additional information regarding these applications and copies of the applications can be obtained by contacting Town Clerk Lyn Neuenfeldt at 920-216-0932 or clerk@townofhortonia.org
 
           Dated this 26th day of August, 2024.
 
                                                                              TOWN OF HORTONIA
 
                                                                              Lyn Neuenfeldt, Town Clerk

titulo: Notice 2023 Open Book and Board of Review
texto:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that an open book will be held on Thursday June 1st, 2023, from 2:00 – 4:00 P.M. at the Hortonia Town Hall for public inspection of the Assessment Roll for the Town of Hortonia.  The town assessor will be present.
     NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Board of Review for the Town of Hortonia, Outagamie County, shall be Thursday May 25th, 2023 2-4 P.M.  Please be advised of the following requirements to appear before the Board of Review and procedural requirements if appearing before the board.
     No person shall be allowed to appear before the Board of Review, to testify to the board by telephone, or to contest the amount of any assessment of real estate or personal property if the person has refused a reasonable written request by certified mail of the assessor to view such property. 
     After the first meeting of the Board of Review and before the board’s final adjournment, no person who is scheduled to appear before the Board of Review may contact, or provide information to a member of the board, about the person’s objection except at a session of the board.
     No person may appear before the Board of Review, testify to the board by telephone or contest the amount of assessment unless at least 48 hours before the first meeting of the board, or at least 48 hours before the objection is heard.  If the objection is allowed because the person had been granted a waiver of the 48 hours notice of intent to file a written objection by appearing before the board during the first two hours of the meeting and showing good cause for failure to meet the 48 hour notice requirement and file a written objection, that the person provides to the clerk of the Board of Review notice as to whether the person will ask for removal and the person’s reasonable estimate of the length of time that the hearing will take.
     When appearing before the board, the person shall specify, in writing, the person’s estimate of the value of the land and of the improvements that are the subject of the person’s objection and specify the information that the person used to arrive at that estimate.
     No person may appear before the Board of Review, testify to the board by telephone or subject or object to a valuation: if that valuation was made by the Assessor of the Objector using the income method; unless the person supplies the Assessor all the information about income method; unless the person supplies the Assessor all the information about income and expenses, as specified in the manual under sec. 73.03(2a) that the Assessor request.  The Town of Hortonia has an ordinance for the confidentiality of information about income and expenses that is provided to the assessor under this paragraph which provides exceptions for persons using information in the discharge of duties imposed by law or of the duties of their officer or by order of a court determined that is provided under this paragraph unless a court determined that it is inaccurate, is not subject to the right of inspection and copy under Sec. 19.35(1) OF Wis. Statutes.
     The Board shall hear upon oath, by telephone, all ill or disabled persons who present to the Board a letter from a physician, surgeon or osteopath that confirms their illness or disability.  No other person may testify by telephone.
Lyn Marie Neuenfeldt
Clerk

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Town of Hortonia, Outagamie County, will conduct the required public test of the tabulating equipment to be used at the March 31st. 2022 at 10 am for the  Spring Election The test will be conducted at the Hortonville Hortonia Fire Hall, 700 W. Nye St. Hortonville. The test is open to the public for viewing, but participation is prohibited.
                                                                                                        Lyn Neuenfeldt, Clerk

titulo: Notice of Public Hearing for Proposed Zoning Change

titulo: Notice of Town Board of Supervisors Meeting
texto: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Town Board of Supervisors meeting of the Town of Hortonia in the County of Outagamie, State of Wisconsin, for the transaction of business as is by law required or permitted to be transacted at such meeting, will be held at the Town Hall - W9702 Givens Rd in said Town on March 16, 2021 7pm for the purpose of a monthly Town Board meeting. A quorum of Plan Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Appeals may be present in the gallery during the meeting. If a meeting is cancelled due to weather or other circumstance, a notice of cancellation will be left on the Town Hall's answering machine: 779- 9780. NOTICE will be posted beside this notice 24hrs prior to the meeting.

Due to Stay at Home order the Town Board will only be addressing Essential business at this time. All other Matters will be postponed until after the order is finished.Monthly Town Board meeting – April 15th at 9am NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Town Board of Supervisors meeting of the Town of Hortonia in the County of Outagamie, State of Wisconsin, for the transaction of business as is by law required or permitted to be transacted at such meeting, will be held at the Town Hall -W9702 Givens Rd in said Town on April 15th at 9 am. for the purpose of a monthly Town Board meeting. A quorum of Plan Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Appeals may be present in the gallery during the meeting. If a meeting is cancelled due to weather or other circumstance, a notice of cancellation will be left on the Town Hall's answering machine: 779-9780. Agenda available from www.townofhortonia.org and will be posted beside this notice 24hrs prior to the meeting. Meeting will be held via Tele-Conference. If you would like to be included please contact the clerk at 920-216-0932 to provide your phone number. Prior to the meeting beginning the clerk will call to include you and send out an agenda via email.

With COVID-19 spreading in The United States there it is important to be up to date on how this affects you. Tony Evers, Governor of Wisconsin has enacted a Safer at Home Order from March 25-April 24. We recommend you all request an absentee ballot for the upcoming election on April 7. You can do so at: https://myvote.wi.gov/en-US/VoteAbsentee. You can get more information on COVID-19 from the WI Health Department: https://www.dhs.wisconsin.gov/covid-19/index.htm or the CDC: https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-nCoV/index.html
